recap: A maid saw Hyde cane Sir Danvers Carew to death and fainted. At two she called police; the mangled body bore a sealed envelope for Utterson, who identified Carew. Inspector Newcomen showed the broken stick, which Utterson recognized as Jekyll’s gift. They searched Hyde’s rooms, finding the other half and a burnt cheque book. Hyde had thousands at the bank, but few familiars, no photograph, and wildly differing descriptions.
